proposal.summary: A flaw in libcap's pthread_create() may cause __real_pthread_create() to return an error, which can lead to process memory exhaustion when exploited.
proposal.cwe_quote: This issue may allow a malicious actor to use cause __real_pthread_create() to return an error, which can exhaust the process memory.

A.quote: which can exhaust the process memory.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Obtain a full technical report or PoC to determine attack vector, affected versions, and reproduction steps; coordinate with maintainers to develop and test a patch that handles __real_pthread_create() errors without leaking or exhausting memory.

evidence_quotes.claim: Description of the flaw and consequence
evidence_quotes.quote: A vulnerability was found in the pthread_create() function in libcap. This issue may allow a malicious actor to use cause __real_pthread_create() to return an error, which can exhaust the process memory.
